query: A person knowingly bought stolen property. What offence may apply?

gold_references.label: Section 317
gold_references.role: receiving stolen property knowing it to be stolen

required_points: Section 317(2) provides that whoever dishonestly receives or retains any stolen property, knowing or having reason to believe it to be stolen property, shall be punished with imprisonment up to three years, or fine, or both.
Knowledge or reason to believe the property is stolen is essential.
optional_points: If the stolen property was obtained through dacoity, enhanced punishment under Section 317(3) applies.
forbidden_points: Buying property without knowledge it is stolen is an offence.
The punishment for receiving stolen property is the same as robbery.
